findings.summary: Legacy chooser dialogs lack an accessible name and do not expose their modal state, leaving background content exposed to assistive technology.
findings.fix: Give the chooser dialog aria-labelledby pointing to its loaded heading (with a unique stable ID) and aria-modal="true", updating the relationship on workflow body replacement. Prefer migrating this Bootstrap branch to the existing labelled a11y-dialog component or native showModal dialog.
findings.evidence: Chromium image/page/document chooser probes: role="dialog", aria-hidden="false", aria-label=null, aria-labelledby=null, aria-modal=null, headings #header-title present. No background aria-hidden or inert. raw/modal-runtime.json.

findings.summary: Tab past the last chooser control moves focus outside the modal, where Escape no longer dismisses it.
findings.fix: Implement explicit Tab and Shift+Tab wrapping between the first and last focusable controls, including document-boundary cases, and handle Escape while the dialog is open. Migrating the shell to the existing a11y-dialog implementation or a native modal dialog can provide these behaviors.
findings.evidence: Chromium image chooser: focus final visible button/input/select/textarea/a; Tab gives document.activeElement=body outside .modal. Escape then leaves .modal.in open. Bootstrap enforces only focusin and binds keyup Escape to .modal. raw/modal-focus.json.

passed: Image, page and document chooser fragments load within the production ModalWorkflow shell and focus initially lands on its dialog container.
Escape dismisses legacy chooser while focus remains inside; its Close button is named.
Legacy chooser close reenables and attempts to return focus to the triggering element; verified source callbacks and visible account-trigger probe.
Privacy dialog uses role=dialog, aria-modal=true and aria-labelledby=title-set-privacy, and closes on Escape in runtime.
Sidebar page explorer is a labelled nonmodal dialog; runtime opens with focus in the explorer and Escape clears its trigger aria-expanded state.
Shared dialog template provides a labelled heading and named close button; DialogController delegates focus management to a11y-dialog.
notes: Runtime evidence saved as raw/modal-runtime.json and raw/modal-focus.json; no screenshots taken.
Chooser probes invoked the production ModalWorkflow API against actual archived image/page/document fragments, without POST requests or fabricated backend responses.

Initial page 68 chooser controls and privacy triggers were hidden in the default archived panel state, so chooser opening was probed through its actual JavaScript API; hidden-trigger focus return from that probe is not reported as a defect.
The focus-boundary probe used a visible sidebar account button as the ModalWorkflow trigger to separate chooser-shell behavior from hidden editor panels.

Privacy dialog opening was probed using its production show event; server-backed privacy submission, validation, nested workflow replacement, and screen-reader virtual cursor behavior remain unverified.
No failure is asserted merely because the existing implementation uses div rather than native dialog.
